items.title: Tuition fees
items.detail: University ki official site se, poore course ke liye. Har saal ki alag likho.

items.title: Rent aur bills
items.detail: Kamra, bijli, internet. Seniors se city ka real kharcha poocho.

items.title: Khaana aur travel
items.detail: Groceries, bus pass, phone. Chhote kharche bhi jodo.

items.title: Emergency buffer
items.detail: Ek hissa alag rakho jo sirf emergency ke liye ho.
